cases.name: Private synthetic PostgreSQL uses Unix socket with no TCP address
Every own department, including inactive rows, is paged once without foreign rows
Stale context is rejected after role downgrade
Stale context is rejected after inactive membership
Department update between pages rejects mixed revisions
Direct SQL change also changes MVCC revision
Employee reassignment invalidates department count snapshot
Foreign organization edits do not invalidate own snapshot
Foreign employee assigned to own department cannot affect exposed employee count
Large Unicode field is split and reconstructed exactly from real PostgreSQL
Paged reads do not change department, employee or audit data

scope: Real isolated Unix-only PostgreSQL with full current Prisma schema and synthetic own/foreign organizations. Actual candidate helper including MVCC revisions and bounded Unicode fragments. No production data/provider calls; route/Next/browser/client page wiring remains unverified.
